subject: MAP weekly: integration task tracker — SDK, auth, streaming, tool-calls
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@integracom.com>, Asha Rao <asha@integracom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly: integration task tracker — SDK, auth, streaming, tool-calls

Hi Samir / Asha —

Following our MAP cadence, attaching the latest MAP PDF and the SDK checklist. This thread is the weekly checkpoint for the integration tasks we committed to last week. Short summary and current asks below.

Attachments: IntegraCom_MAP_v2.pdf, sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx

Status snapshot (high level):
- SDK (client libs): Redwood devs delivered pre-release JS/Go SDKs; IntegraCom needs to validate auth flow against their staging env. Owner: Camila (Redwood) / Samir (IntegraCom).
- Auth: OAuth + token exchange. IntegraCom to confirm if they can support the delegated-scope we discussed (api:read, api:write). Owner: Karthik (Redwood) / Asha (IntegraCom).
- Streaming: Continuous chunked responses tested locally; streaming de-dup and reconnect logic still WIP. Owner: Monica (Redwood).
- Tool calling / function routing: Redwood side: function-schema v1 implemented; IntegraCom to provide sample tool manifest by EOD Thu. Owner: Laura (Redwood) / integracom-dev (IntegraCom).

Open asks for IntegraCom:
1) Confirm support for delegated-scope by Thu 2026-07-09 EOD (affects auth path).
2) Share tool manifest sample and any per-tool rate limits by Thu.
3) Validation schedule: would you prefer a short validation call or running the SDK smoke tests in your CI?

Redwood next steps (what we own):
- Camila will push a 0.2.1 SDK build with improved error codes (ETA Wed 07/08).
- Karthik to provide a small auth test harness for your team to exercise token exchange (ETA Thu 07/09).
- Monica to run streaming stress tests and share latency/throughput numbers (ETA Fri 07/10).

Suggested next checkpoint: same time next week (Tue 07/14) unless you want daily quick syncs while auth is in flight.

Thanks — looking to keep the runway clean so we hit the target for the pilot close.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@integracom.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@integracom.com>, integracom-dev@integracom.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: integration task tracker — SDK, auth, streaming, tool-calls

Vivek — thanks for the clear rundown. Quick updates from our side: 

- Auth: We can support delegated-scope but will need the exact scope strings. One small ask: can Redwood add a short-lived refresh token option for CI testing? That would make our automated runs easier.
- Tool manifest: attaching a minimal sample (see integracom-dev@example.com drop) — we will add rate limits tomorrow.
- SDK: can you confirm the JS SDK surfaces a retryable error class so we can detect transient backend failures?

Planned dates from IntegraCom:
- Scope strings + tool manifest (initial): Thu 07/09
- CI smoke run: target Mon 07/13 in staging (we'll confirm by Fri)

We prefer a short async validation (we'll run your SDK smoke tests in our CI and then do a 30-min sync if failures pop up).

On the refresh-token option: agree it's useful — Samir will work with integracom-dev to confirm security constraints, and loop back by Thu.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Product Integrations | IntegraCom

Looping in quick internal ownership notes and mitigations — copying the external thread so nothing gets lost.

Internal owners (confirmed):
- SDK: Camila -> validate JS/Go surface, add RetryableError class (action: Camila). Target publish: Wed 07/08.
- Auth: Karthik -> deliver auth harness + exact scope strings and refresh-token option. Action: Karthik to drop harness + docs by Thu 07/09.
- Streaming: Monica -> run stress tests and prepare fallback plan (polling fallback + reduced shard batch) if reconnect jitter persists. Deliverable: streaming-report Fri 07/10.
- Tool calls: Laura -> prepare a tool-calls conformance checklist and host a 30-min runbook review on Thu 07/09 11:00 PT. Laura to invite integracom-dev.

Risks & mitigations:
- If IntegraCom cannot provide stable tool manifests by Thu, we will mock tools and proceed with an alpha validation; that will likely push the pilot close by ~1 week.
- Auth scope mismatch is the highest risk; Karthik will surface exact scope strings and propose a short refresh-token flow for CI to reduce friction.

I've created a quick ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4321 and added the owners. Please add any missing acceptance criteria into the ticket.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
